n: The word of the week was permission. One agent app now shows you what it is about to do and waits before it sends or pays, one lab now trains its biggest models with no internet at all, and a government institute published what happened when a model under test acted on real people anyway. When a tool can act for you, find the line it will not cross without you, and check that it is written down.
